cards.title: About KML Format
cards.body: KML (Keyhole Markup Language) is an XML format used by Google Earth and Google Maps for displaying geographic data.

cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX (GPS Exchange Format) is the standard format for GPS data, supported by most GPS devices and fitness trackers.

cards.title: Why Convert KML to GPX?
items: Import Google Earth data into GPS devices
Use with fitness tracking apps (Strava, Garmin Connect)
Compatible with hiking and navigation apps
